papers.title_en: Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training
papers.authors: Tao Huang, Chen Zhu, Antonio Alonso, Daming Li, Adarsh Goura, Jaideep Ray, Yitong Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向变成本分布式训练的免协调批成本前瞻调度
papers.tldr: 同步数据并行训练中，变长样本导致各rank计算负载不均、产生大量空闲时间。本文提出无协调的Batch Cost Lookahead（BCL）数据加载策略，在本地缓冲窗口内按预估成本重划分等大小批次。实验显示其将单rank批次成本方差最高降低82.8%，加速比达1.05–1.34。该方法在数据加载层即缓解变量成本失衡，无需修改训练逻辑或跨rank通信。
papers.abstract_en: Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be removed at the data-loader boundary, while clarifying when data preparation or broader coordination is still necessary.

papers.title_en: Exact Makespan Bounds and the GPipe Homogeneity Bias for Heterogeneous LLM Inference Pipelines
papers.authors: Zhu Wenbo
papers.evidence: 异构GPU集群上LLM推理流水线的精确完工时间建模
papers.tldr: LLM推理流水线在异构GPU集群上存在makespan建模偏差。本文给出微批处理流水线makespan的精确临界路径刻画，推导三种通信模型下的闭式解。揭示GPipe公式高估源于同质性假设与通信忽略，量化两类误差项。为异构部署提供首个严格理论基准与优化指导。
papers.abstract_en: We give an exact critical-path characterization of the makespan of micro-batch pipelines serving LLMs on heterogeneous GPU clusters, quantifying how the classic homogeneous GPipe formula errs. In the pure-forward, communication-free, infinite-buffer setting, T(M) = (M-1)tau_max + Sum_j tau_j, where tau_j is stage j's per-micro-batch service time and M the micro-batch count (Theorem 1). Under asynchronous communication -- modern NCCL-based serving -- it extends to T(M) = Sum_j tau_j + Sum_j d_j + (M-1)tau_max, with Sum_j d_j a purely additive constant (Theorem 2); under blocking communication, T(M) = (M-1)sigma_max + Sum_s sigma_s with sigma_s = tau_s + d_s, so communication enters the steady-state slope iff some d_s > tau_max - tau_s (Theorem 3). These results quantify the GPipe overestimate, decompose the bias into a homogeneity term Sum_j (tau_max - tau_j) and a communication-ignoring term Sum_j d_j, and imply that balancing per-stage compute dominates communication reduction for steady-state throughput. A real system with partial overlap is sandwiched between Theorems 2 and 3, with a closed-form bound on the overlap throughput gain. All claims are validated pointwise (error < 10^-9) on eleven configurations and a 1.6x10^5-point fuzz, including a mixed RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070 partition. We situate the results in flow-shop scheduling and list open extensions: bandwidth-limited communication, bounded buffers, prefill-decode interleaving.

papers.title_en: ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models
papers.authors: Mianjie Yu, Zhongmin Zhao, Zizhao Mo, Jianxiong Liao, Wenxuan Li, Yulin Qiao, Huanle Xu, Wenquan Yang, Yongqiang Yang, Zeren Li, Ruifeng Tang, Chengzhong Xu
papers.evidence: 面向大模型训练的数据均衡异构流水线并行系统
papers.tldr: 现有异构训练系统通过不等分层数实现粗粒度计算负载均衡，但忽视显存约束且平衡粒度粗糙。本文提出HPP细粒度数据均衡机制，并设计ETH系统联合优化跨阶段与阶段内负载。ETH采用分块梯度聚合与层次化搜索优化，实测提速2倍、配置开销降56倍。该工作为异构硬件上大模型高效训练提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity. In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. To mitigate asymmetric communication costs, ETH implements block-wise gradient aggregation. Furthermore, it integrates specialized optimizations that dramatically reduce HPP configuration search overhead. Evaluations demonstrate ETH achieves up to 2x training speedup while reducing configuration generation overhead by up to 56x compared to state-of-the-art systems. The code is available at https://github.com/YuMJie/ETH.

papers.title_en: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhang, Arshad Rahman, Adnan Aziz, Ajith Prabhudev, Amin Farmahini, Ben Rhoads, Benson Ma, Brian Shi, Cen Zhao, CK Luk, Dingming Wu, Emad El-Haraty, Eric Chen, Frank Li, Gary Huang, Gefei Zuo, Haoran Zhang, Hiwot Kassa, Hongyi Zeng, Jack Taylor, Jeremy Hadidjojo, John Donati, Jonathan Sheffield, Julio Machado Silva, Karthik Ganesan, Kent Russell, KR Kishore, Lei Tian, Liu Ke, Muhammad Osama, Peng Chen, Rakesh Hemnani, Ryan Swann, Saleel Kudchadker, Shankar Yanamandram, Shobhit Kanaujia, Shucai Xiao, Srinath Bayareddy, Srinivas Vaidyanathan, Sudharssun Subramanian, Supadchaya Puangpontip, Taylor Robie, Tianhao Huang, Tyler Hart, Viswesh Sankaran, Weijun Jiang, Wenkai Du, Xiaodong Wang, Xiaohu Guo, Yao Rong, Yinbin Ma, Yue Dong, Yuzhen Huang, Yvonne Liu, Zhan Shu, Dan Rabinovitsj, Ajit Mathews, Chunqiang Tang
papers.evidence: 覆盖NVIDIA、AMD与MTIA加速器的端到端AI训练协同设计
papers.tldr: Meta为应对硬件异构与厂商锁定问题，系统性推进AMD GPU在大模型训练中的落地。提出硬件-模型协同设计、分析型性能建模与智能体驱动的微架构适配三大原则。端到端训练吞吐提升1.5倍，MI350X相较B200实现HBM容量优势转化。首例超大规模生产级AMD GPU训练实践，核心优化已回馈PyTorch/Triton/ROCm。
papers.abstract_en: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. Third, increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the CUDA ecosystem; we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. Compared to the directly ported baseline, these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. To our knowledge, this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing AMD GPUs for large-scale training. Our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems.

papers.title_en: MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches
papers.authors: Seungkwan Kang, Hyungseok Ko, Heemin Kim, Myoungsoo Jung
papers.evidence: 基于SSD的端到端KV缓存片上执行，优化LLM推理部署栈
papers.tldr: 边缘设备RAG因prefill阶段长度不对称成为性能瓶颈，预计算KV缓存又引发SSD-主机间I/O墙。MemLLM提出端到端存内处理架构，在SSD内执行完整注意力计算。实测平均端到端加速4.06×，PCIe出口带宽恒定O(1)。首次实现DRAM-less、零拷贝、框架透明的RAG存内加速。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.

papers.title_en: CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet
papers.authors: Michael Wasef, Gongjin Sun, Edmund Au, Ranjitha Gopalakrishna, Elham Movahedian, Dongyang Li, Senthil Murugesapandian, Caroline Kahn, Shuyu Lyu, Brian Luu, Jason Scott, Namita Kumar, Mehdi Nik, Kwan Huen, Xuebin Yao, Amir Beygi, Luis Vitorio Cargnini, Ramdas Kachare
papers.evidence: 基于CXL的内存池架构直接支撑AI工作负载所需的可扩展GPU/CPU内存扩展
papers.tldr: 新兴内存密集型负载亟需可扩展、低成本的内存池化方案。CMM-MP首创融合CXL与以太网的专用内存池设备，实现无侵入式TB级内存扩展。实测延迟2.7 μs、吞吐23 GB/s，显著优于RDMA方案。该架构支持池化与共享双模式，已验证于Valkey+YCSB和DiskANN场景。
papers.abstract_en: CXL Memory Module - Memory Pooling (CMM-MP) introduces a novel memory pooling architecture to meet the unique requirements of emerging memory-intensive workloads. This industry-first, purpose-built memory-pooling device combines the benefits of Compute Express Link (CXL) with the scalability and cost advantages of Ethernet. Multiple CMM-MP devices together provide a flexible, composable, and disaggregated memory expansion solution. The CMM-MP enables 100s of TB capacity for GPU/CPU applications without modifications. The memory pool is exposed as a large-capacity logical aggregate memory, with all pool discovery, composition, and backend network datapath tasks fully offloaded to the device. CMM-MP supports both memory pooling and sharing usage modes. It provides an application latency of 2.7 us and up to 23 GB/s of memory throughput. Our evaluations demonstrate that CMM-MP significantly outperforms RDMA-based solutions in latency and throughput. We also evaluated real-world use cases of Valkey+YCSB and DiskANN using CMM-MP.

papers.title_en: BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs
papers.authors: Mingshu Zhai, Minkun Guo, Hongrui Lian, Shuangyu Li, Qi Zhang, Chen Hu, Xiawei Du, Yuyang Jin, Zan Zong, Jidong Zhai
papers.evidence: 面向万卡级大模型训练的动态显存调配系统
papers.tldr: 细粒度MoE模型训练中动态专家负载不均衡引发显著显存波动，严重拖累效率。BaGuaLu-2将显存分配从静态预设转为按批精确供给的连续调控。在12,288 GPU上训练1040B参数模型，达2 EFlops与35% MFU。首次实现万卡级MoE训练中零OOM、零闲置的弹性显存管理。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is the de facto architecture for scaling large language models. However, dynamic expert load imbalance causes severe memory fluctuations that degrade training efficiency. Existing systems rely on static memory provisioning: they either over-provision, leaving GPU memory idle during normal execution, or under- provision, inviting out-of-memory crashes and costly manual rollbacks when load spikes occur. To address these challenges, we propose BaGuaLu-2, a large-scale MoE training system that eliminates this dilemma through flexible provisioning. By transforming memory allocation from a static, one-time tuning choice into a continuous and fine-grained control. BaGuaLu-2 grants exact activation memory on demand for each training batch. Furthermore, it offsets any dynamic management overhead through system optimizations. BaGuaLu-2 demonstrates exceptional scalability, training a model with 1040 billion parameters across 12,288 GPUs while sustaining over 2 EFlops at 35% MFU. Compared with state-of-the-art systems, BaGuaLu-2 delivers 1.14x and 1.13x average throughput improvements over Megatron-Kuai and AdaPipe, respectively.

papers.title_en: ScaleRAN: A Runtime for Elastic GPU Resource Management in AI-RAN
papers.authors: Arthur Hamard, Jérémie Leguay, Gopalasingham Aravinthan, Alberto Conte, Julien Lallet, Abdelkader Outtagarts
papers.evidence: 面向AI-RAN基础设施的弹性GPU资源管理运行时
papers.tldr: AI-RAN需在GPU平台上协同运行时延敏感的RAN基带处理与AI任务，但现有GPU共享机制难以应对毫秒级slot负载波动。ScaleRAN基于NVIDIA Green Contexts实现SM级弹性分区，支持slot粒度动态资源重分配。实验表明其在保障RAN截止期前提下显著提升AI任务可用GPU资源。该工作为O-RAN O-Cloud等AI-RAN部署提供了首个轻量、可预测的节点级GPU运行时。
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN is driving the convergence of radio access network (RAN) processing and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads on GPU-enabled computing platforms, ranging from GPU-accelerated base stations to cloud-native infrastructures. While GPU acceleration improves the efficiency of virtualized RAN functions, the computational demand of latency-critical baseband processing varies with traffic load, creating transient spare GPU capacity that can be reclaimed by co-located AI applications. Existing GPU-sharing mechanisms rely on coarse-grained hardware partitioning or static resource allocation, limiting their ability to adapt to slot-level workload fluctuations while preserving strict timing requirements.   This paper presents ScaleRAN, a node-local runtime for elastic GPU resource management in AI-RAN. ScaleRAN leverages NVIDIA Green Contexts to dynamically partition Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) between RAN and AI workloads through a ladder of pre-created GPU partitions, enabling low-overhead resource reallocation at RAN slot granularity. The proposed runtime naturally supports Open-RAN (O-RAN) O-Cloud deployments, one representative AI-RAN deployment scenario. To drive these reallocations, we propose a reactive controller inspired by Kubernetes autoscaling and a proactive controller based on quantile regression and conformal prediction. We also develop LDPCSim, a GPU-accelerated workload generator built on NVIDIA Aerial for reproducible evaluation. Results show that predictive fine-grained GPU partitioning satisfies slot-level RAN deadlines while increasing the GPU resources available to co-located AI workloads, demonstrating the practicality of elastic GPU sharing for future AI-RAN platforms.

papers.title_en: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Yujia Fu, Yue Yu, Dan Huang
papers.evidence: 面向DNN推理GPU共享的算子级干扰建模
papers.tldr: GPU共享推理常因算子间干扰导致性能下降，但现有方法缺乏细粒度建模。PairSight首次在SM分区下开展算子级干扰实证分析，定位到共享内存路径上的联合争用。其硬件感知预测器在6个DNN（含LLM）上实现4.3%平均误差，显著优于基线并支持快速泛化。为GPU多租户推理提供了可解释、高精度的干扰建模新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Serving DNN inference is costly, yet a single task seldom saturates both the compute units and the memory bandwidth of a GPU. GPU sharing raises utilization by co-locating several tasks on one GPU, at the cost of interference among them. Existing systems estimate this interference with binary compute-memory rules, standalone scaling curves, or model-level predictors. However, these estimates rest on a limited understanding of interference. They leave the software and hardware properties of co-located operators largely unexplored and give no slowdown prediction that is both interpretable and accurate. We conduct an operator-level study of interference under SM partitioning and use hardware counters to trace it to contention on the shared memory path, where the slowdown depends jointly on both co-located operators. Based on these findings, we propose PairSight, a hardware-aware interference predictor that learns how the hardware behaviors of co-located tasks interact and predicts the latency of each task before co-location. On six DNN models including LLMs, PairSight predicts latency under sharing with 4.3% mean error, against 19.0% for a compute-memory intensity rule, and adapts to unseen models and inputs with a few samples.

papers.title_en: qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators
papers.authors: Leandro Fiorin, Luigi Altamura, Cristina Silvano
papers.evidence: 多精度加速器映射框架
papers.tldr: 面向多精度AI加速器的DNN映射优化存在设计空间巨大、硬件-算法协同难的问题。qGAMMA提出基于领域遗传算法与硬件合成驱动分析模型的联合搜索框架。在多个DNN负载上实现性能、能效与资源利用率的帕累托最优权衡。为混合精度应用设计与加速器配置提供可复现、可扩展的自动化方法论。
papers.abstract_en: This work describes qGAMMA, a flexible framework for exploring and optimizing the mapping of mixed-precision Deep Neural Network (DNN) models onto general-purpose spatial accelerators that support a range of fixed- and floating-point precisions. qGAMMA navigates the design space using a domain-specific genetic algorithm and an analytical performance model based on hardware synthesis results. The framework identifies the optimal mapping and accelerator configuration that minimizes target metrics. Extensive evaluations across DNN workloads show that qGAMMA offers valuable insights for designing mixed-precision applications, enabling better trade-offs between performance, energy efficiency, and resource utilization.

papers.title_en: Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains
papers.authors: Murali Emani, Kashyap R Manjusha
papers.evidence: 基于LLM多智能体的异构AI系统设计自动化框架
papers.tldr: 现代AI/HPC系统设计面临芯片、Scale-Up、Scale-Out多维异构组合爆炸问题。ArchAgent提出LLM规划器+专科代理+解析评估器的分层多智能体框架。在1MW功耗约束下，对混合AI+HPC负载实现1.93×加权几何平均加速。显著优于基线且仅需18次评估，验证了数据高效、可解释的系统级协同设计新范式。
papers.abstract_en: The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory tech- nologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents. A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM. On a mixed AI+HPC workload under a 1 MW power budget, ArchAgent discovers heterogeneous designs that achieve a 1.93x weighted geometric mean speedup over a homogeneous GPU baseline, while requiring only 18 evaluations compared with 100 evaluations for hill climbing, which achieves 1.65x speedup.

papers.title_en: TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs
papers.authors: Guangyuan Xu, Lanxuan Zhang, Ziyang Li, Zhaoshi Li, Yajun Ha
papers.evidence: 面向异构加速器架构的GPU内存布局优化
papers.tldr: 现代GPU编译器缺乏对3D DRAM中张量分块（tile）布局的显式控制，导致严重行缓冲冲突。TileDRAM提出编译器可见的tile-to-DRAM布局抽象，基于访问签名动态选择最优布局。在MoE FFN负载上将加权行冲突率从75.7%降至15.2%，获得1.77×几何平均加速。该方法无需硬件修改，仅靠地址算术实现，具强可移植性。
papers.abstract_en: Modern GPU compilers expose rich layout abstractions for mapping tensors to threads and on-chip resources, but compute-unit-local (CU-local) 3D DRAM architectures lack a corresponding abstraction for specifying how operand-tile data are   arranged within the DRAM address space. Without such an abstraction, conventional placement under the existing DRAM address mapping can subject structured tile accesses to severe row-buffer conflicts. We present TileDRAM, a compiler-runtime   toolchain that introduces tile-to-DRAM layouts as a compiler-visible abstraction for DRAM placement. TileDRAM extends the GPU Linear Layout abstraction from compute-side mapping targets to DRAM placement coordinates and selects layouts per   tile access signature, using recurring tile-local access behavior as the specialization unit. Since row-buffer locality depends on ordered request history, TileDRAM evaluates candidate layouts through their row-buffer behavior under fixed   DRAM address mappings. Accesses under the selected layouts are realized through ordinary address arithmetic, without new address-remapping hardware or ISA support. In full-trace replay on Accel-Sim/Ramulator2 across 108 mixture-of-experts   (MoE) feed-forward network (FFN) cases, TileDRAM reduces the request-weighted row-conflict rate from 75.7% to 15.2% and achieves a 1.77x geomean speedup. Retargeting six traces to six 3D DRAM organizations yields a 2.20x geomean speedup   under the same compiler abstraction. On an RTX 3090, address transformation adds 0.17% geomean overhead over identity.

papers.title_en: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.authors: Javid Baydamirli, Didem Unat
papers.evidence: 针对InfiniBand/RoCE上GPU/CPU发起的RDMA通信进行细粒度可观测性分析
papers.tldr: RDMA网络在大规模系统中广泛应用，但缺乏细粒度可观测性，尤其GPU发起的RDMA操作完全不可见。SigmaTrace在libibverbs/mlx5dv层实现库无关追踪，采用内存插桩技术首次无侵入式捕获GPU端内核RDMA行为。实测NCCL/RCCL通信开销仅增1.3%–2%，并揭示了现有工具无法发现的内核屏障扩散与2.13倍跨节点流量倾斜。该工作填补了CPU/GPU协同RDMA可观测性的关键空白。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host.   We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation.   Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.

papers.title_en: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI Inference
papers.authors: Liang Su, David Chen, Jason Li, Kevin Guo, Teresa Lv
papers.evidence: 面向低延迟物理AI推理的模型-硬件流水线协同设计
papers.tldr: 物理AI（如VLA/VA/WAM）实时单批推理受系统级开销主导，而非算子内核速度。FlashRT-PAI提出模型-硬件流水线协同设计，融合深度核融合、执行契约与状态胶囊三大机制。在RTX 5090和Jetson AGX Thor上实现1.3–3.7×加速，四比特pi0.5在LIBERO-10达94.04%成功率。开源并已集成至LeRobot框架，推动低延迟物理AI部署落地。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. General-purpose graph compilers cannot address these costs, as they optimize individual calls in isolation and lack visibility into cross-call state semantics and global pipeline structure. We present FLASHRT-PAI, a low-latency inference engine built around model-hardware pipeline co-design rather than isolated kernel optimization. FLASHRT-PAI combines three core mechanisms: deep kernel fusion with launch overlap eliminates inter-operator boundaries and launch gaps; an execution contract formalizes the pipeline's stage DAG, update rates, and named buffers to enable cross-decision state reuse and selective refresh; and execution-state capsules enable fast snapshot, restore, and fork of persistent pipeline state. The system also supports drop-in acceleration of unmodified PyTorch models via parity- and latency-gated kernel replacement. Evaluation covers six policies on RTX 5090 and four on Jetson AGX Thor. At matched 16-bit precision, FLASHRT-PAI is 1.3-3.7x faster than official compiled paths. Combining pipeline co-design with reduced precision delivers 3.38-12.66x speedup over official eager implementations. In LIBERO-10, four-bit pi0.5 achieves 94.04% success on Thor and 93.32% on RTX 5090, compared with 92.4% for the measured official FP16 reference. FLASHRT-PAI is open source, distributed via Hugging Face Kernel Hub, and its opt-in pi0.5 kernels have been adopted into the LeRobot framework.

papers.title_en: Koi: Evidence-Guided, Self-Calibrating Planning for Multi-Cloud, Heterogeneous LLM Inference Fleets
papers.authors: Mankeerat Sidhu, Gangmuk Lim, Hetarth Chopra, Maximillian Eisenberg, Quan Hao Ng, Aryan Gosaliya, Shu Liu, Luka Govedič, Jiaxin Shan, Hongkuan Zhou, Vikram Sharma Mailthody, P. Brighten Godfrey, Ion Stoica
papers.evidence: 面向异构多云LLM推理集群的自校准调度规划器
papers.tldr: LLM推理部署需在多云异构环境中协调百余变量，决策高度耦合且动态变化。Koi提出RLM层级推理+因果图建模的自校准规划框架，实时更新部署知识。实测goodput提升1.18倍、$/token降20%。首次实现证据驱动、可演化的集群级LLM推理规划系统。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a large language model (LLM) requires choosing the right accelerator, parallelization strategy, engine configuration, and replica count amongst ~140 other variables across clouds, regions, and markets. These decisions are intertwined, and the best cluster-wide plan continually changes as jobs contend for shared capacity on shifting workloads. We present Koi, a self-calibrating cluster planner for heterogeneous, multi-cloud fleets. Koi uses a Recursive Language Model (RLM) hierarchy to propose hypotheses and reason over deployment while deterministic components predict serving behavior, score candidates, and control placement. It represents inference behavior as a fixed causal graph linking decisions (e.g., accelerator, parallelism), runtime mediators (e.g., KV-cache pressure, communication overhead), and outcomes (e.g., latency, throughput). Each deployment strengthens or weakens scoped causal relationships, building a comprehensive playbook for inference that the planner employs to guide future decisions. Job-wise configurations are composed into cluster-wide plans and evaluated against serving objectives, resource constraints, SLO risks, and cost. Across benchmarks, Koi achieves 1.18x greater goodput than the strongest baseline while reducing $/token by 20% in a real heterogeneous cluster. Ablations isolate the contribution of Koi's architecture: a pure language model attains a composite score of 35.3, the same model equipped with Koi's deterministic tools reaches 51.6, and the full Koi planner reaches 70.8.

papers.title_en: Ineffective Occupancy in Heterogeneous GPU Clusters: Prediction, Contribution Analysis, and Readiness-Aware Scheduling
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Bin Liao
papers.evidence: 异构GPU集群中无效占用问题的分析与调度优化
papers.tldr: 异构GPU集群中存在大量无效占用：作业已调度但长期无法就绪，造成资源浪费。本文提出就绪感知调度RAS，基于9个 admission 时可观测特征预测就绪概率。在阿里GPU集群trace上，无效占用率从43.64%降至27.15%，大请求有效覆盖率提升17.07个百分点。证明就绪状态是可测、可预测、可优化的关键调度维度。
papers.abstract_en: In heterogeneous GPU clusters, GPUs are costly and scarce, yet placing a job on a machine does not mean that the job becomes ready to run. A large amount of allocated capacity can remain occupied for long periods without producing useful computation, further aggravating the waste of compute resources. On the Alibaba GPU cluster trace we find that, even when GPU capacity is sufficient and placement is complete, 52.70% of execution records never became ready. We term this phenomenon ineffective occupancy. Building on this diagnosis, and keeping the placement policy fixed, we propose Readiness-Aware Scheduling (RAS): it uses only nine attributes observable at admission time to predict readiness probability and reorders admission accordingly. Under a five-fold split grouped by machine, the gradient-boosted model reaches an ROC-AUC of 0.8187. A feature-group contribution analysis shows that the model's score is driven mainly by job profile, duration, and GPU model, with the request-size group contributing least, followed by the scheduling and concurrency group. In GPU terms, RAS reduces the ineffective-occupancy ratio (the share of cluster GPUs held under ineffective occupancy) from 43.64% to 27.15% and raises the effective coverage of large requests (eight GPUs or more) from 46.11% to 63.18%, without sacrificing capacity utilization. Relative to the upper bound obtained by ordering with ground-truth labels, RAS captures 65.1% of the attainable improvement, well above the interpretable rules built only from the contribution-analysis conclusions; the gain therefore comes mainly from predicting with all nine attributes jointly rather than from combining rules built on any single attribute group. These results indicate that readiness status is a measurable, predictable, and optimizable dimension of admission decisions in heterogeneous GPU clusters.

papers.title_en: An Information-Geometric Framework for OCS-Reconfigurable Interconnect Topology in Large-Scale AI Clusters
papers.authors: Shintaro Yoshizawa
papers.evidence: 面向AI集群光电路交换可重构互连拓扑的信息几何框架
papers.tldr: AI集群中OCS可编程互连拓扑设计面临布线选择、对称性偏离与动态重配置难题。本文构建信息几何框架，将布线建模为概率单纯形上的点，以KL散度度量偏离，用平滑DAG关键路径长度建模成本。理论证明自由能优化的良定性与对称性原理，提出熵正则化近端梯度法并获线性收敛。实验在pipeline/data/MoE负载上优于整数规划。
papers.abstract_en: Optical Circuit Switches (OCS) make inter-pod wiring in AI clusters programmable, posing design questions on wiring choice, symmetry departure, and reconfigurations. We present a unified information-geometric framework to address these issues.A wiring is a point in a probability simplex over circuits within a degree polytope. Departure from a symmetric Fat-Tree prior $\mathbf{q}$ is measured by $\DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$. The cost $U$ is the smoothed DAG critical-path length, whose gradient equals path marginals of a Gibbs distribution via forward--backward recursion.For free energy $F_{β_1} = U + β_1^{-1} \DKL(\cdot \,\|\, \mathbf{q})$, we prove well-posedness, monotonic dependence on $β_1$, adaptation bounds via Jeffreys divergence, and a symmetry principle for static optimality. An entropic proximal-gradient method updates multiplicatively with a $|V|$-dim dual KL projection, achieving linear convergence.For time-varying traffic, a threshold policy yields regret $O(\sqrt{ΓC V_1 T})$ against the switching-free optimum. Traffic changes are detected by a multinomial GLR--CUSUM detector with non-asymptotic false-alarm bounds. Multi-job generalized-mean fairness aligns with $α$-fairness ($α\ge 2$). Experiments on pipeline, data, and MoE workloads validate the framework against integer programming.

papers.title_en: gKSM: GPU Memory Deduplication at Driver Layer for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Shuheng Gao, Fan Guo, Yongkun Li, Ziye Yue, Yinlong Xu, John C. S. Lui
papers.evidence: 面向无服务器LLM推理的GPU内存去重框架
papers.tldr: 服务器无服务器LLM推理中，多实例共驻单GPU导致模型权重与运行时状态重复占用GPU内存。gKSM在驱动层实现透明GPU内存去重，融合CPU-GPU协同哈希、零拷贝权重去重与跨特权页错误处理。实测GPU内存降低59.8%，内存受限下聚合吞吐提升2.15倍。首次在GPU侧高效支持写隔离与COW语义，显著提升资源利用率与服务可用性。
papers.abstract_en: In serverless LLM inference, cloud providers commonly locate multiple instances on a single GPU to improve utilization. However, each instance independently maintains its model weights and runtime state, making duplicate GPU memory the primary bottleneck. Memory deduplication is a widely-used technique for eliminating duplicate data in CPU systems, but extending it to GPU memory faces fundamental challenges. Effective GPU memory deduplication must avoid redundant data movement between CPU and GPU while preserving write isolation for shared pages without native copy-on-write (COW) support.   This paper presents gKSM, a transparent GPU memory deduplication framework for serverless LLM inference. gKSM addresses these challenges through CPU-GPU collaborative hash management that offloads hash computation to GPU kernels, zero-copy model weight deduplication that eliminates duplication before model weight transfer, and a cross-privilege page fault handler that combines a lightweight kernel hook and CUDA Virtual Memory Management (VMM) remapping in the user space. gKSM also designs a stable page scanning algorithm and a reuse-aware placement policy in cluster scale. Experiments show that gKSM reduces GPU memory usage by 59.8% while maintaining high throughput compared to ServerlessLLM. Under memory constrained workloads, gKSM improves aggregate throughput by 2.15X and supports five instances concurrently. In cluster level simulation, gKSM achieves a service rate of 99.97%, compared to 78.2% for SLInfer and 26.9% for ServerlessLLM.

papers.title_en: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
papers.authors: Mobina Kashaniyan, Ali Jannesari
papers.evidence: GPU资源争用下自适应测试时缩放的LLM推理框架
papers.tldr: 测试时缩放（TTS）通过多采样提升LLM推理能力，但固定预算忽视查询难度与GPU争用下的动态能耗。ATEST提出资源感知的自适应TTS框架，支持在线学习能耗并动态终止采样。在A100上实现零超能、高准确率与负载自适应降采样，显著优于静态预算方法。为LLM服务在波动负载下的能效-精度协同优化提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

papers.title_en: GeoTrain: Energy-Aware Automatic Parallelism for Foundation Model Training on Heterogeneous Geo-Distributed Resources
papers.authors: Bui-Khanh Hoang, TianZhang He, Mohammad Goudarzi
papers.evidence: GeoTrain：面向地理分布式GPU的基石模型训练自动并行化
papers.tldr: 前沿大模型训练依赖昂贵集中式集群，而地理分布式GPU资源存在显著异构性与高能耗问题。GeoTrain提出联合优化训练性能与能耗的自动并行策略，支持异构计算、内存、功耗与网络约束。实验显示其迭代时间降低61.4%，能耗减少11.7%。该工作为绿色、普惠的大模型训练提供了可扩展新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Training foundation models at the frontier typically requires large-scale dedicated and centralized clusters with fast interconnects - infrastructure that is prohibitively expensive and generally accessible only to well-resourced organizations. Decentralized training over pooled, geographically distributed GPUs offers an alternative, but introduces substantial heterogeneity in compute, memory, power, and network performance. Existing distributed training systems are primarily designed for clusters with fast, low-latency interconnects and typically use all available GPUs when configuring parallel training. In geo-distributed environments, however, slower devices and weak network links can become bottlenecks, while optimizing solely for throughput overlooks significant energy cost.   We present GeoTrain, an automatic parallelism system that jointly optimizes training performance and energy consumption for heterogeneous geo-distributed GPU environments. GeoTrain simultaneously selects GPUs, partitions model layers, and determines pipeline configurations while accounting for heterogeneous compute, memory, power, and network constraints. To efficiently explore this large combinatorial search space, GeoTrain employs an optimized memetic algorithm with specialized genetic operators and local search. Experiments with decoder-only Transformer models on real-world and simulated heterogeneous topologies demonstrate that GeoTrain reduces iteration time and energy consumption by up to $61.4\%$ and $11.7\%$, respectively, over the existing state-of-the-art approaches. It also finds the exact optimum on verifiable instances and scales beyond exact methods as the number of GPUs increases, while exposing favorable energy-time trade-offs, including cases where its time-optimal distributed training plan is both faster and more energy-efficient than the baselines.

papers.title_en: VS-Flash: Harnessing Vector Search with Computational Memory-Semantic Flash
papers.authors: Donguk Kim, Sangjun Pae, Daeyoung Lee, Dong Kim
papers.evidence: 利用计算型闪存语义存储加速向量搜索
papers.tldr: 向量数据库因RAG需求激增而突破主机DRAM容量，现有SSD mmap方案在高并发近似最近邻搜索下资源争用严重。VS-Flash提出内存语义闪存架构与动态计算卸载机制，在同一数据段上分流大小批量查询。实测三组十亿级数据集，吞吐提升最高达57.4倍，p99延迟降低24.8倍。该设计首次实现容量扩展、吞吐提升与尾延迟优化的协同突破。
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI continues to evolve, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are driving rapid growth in vector database capacity requirements. As datasets outgrow host DRAM, vector databases rely on MMap-based serving over SSDs to extend capacity. However, high-fan-out ANN searches generate concurrent irregular accesses that contend for host memory and storage resources, degrading bulk throughput and inflating tail latency under mixed workloads. In this paper, we address these challenges through memory-semantic capacity and workload-aware compute placement. VS-Flash exposes flash as a large-capacity memory-semantic space and dynamically selects the execution engine according to runtime query and workload characteristics. It offloads throughput-oriented large-batch queries to a Computational Memory-Semantic Flash (CMS-Flash) device, while executing latency-sensitive small-batch queries on the host CPU. Both paths access the same resident segments, avoiding a separate host-DRAM replica. Across three billion-scale datasets, VS-Flash improves bulk-search throughput over vanilla Milvus by 36.8X on average, with up to a 57.4X improvement. Under mixed workloads, VS-Flash reduces the p99 latency of latency-sensitive requests by up to 24.8X while sustaining device-side bulk search. These results show that VS-Flash delivers scalable vector search beyond host DRAM capacity while jointly improving bulk throughput and small-request tail latency.

papers.title_en: 3D-MoE: Complementarity-Guided Hardware-Software Co-Design for MoE Decode on 3D-Stacked NMP
papers.authors: Yudong Pan, Lian Liu, Shixin Zhao, Yintao He, Kaiyan Chang, Tianhua Han, Chenyang Ai, Haonan Zhu, Mengdi Wang, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang
papers.evidence: 面向3D堆叠近存处理架构的MoE解码软硬件协同设计与专家负载均衡
papers.tldr: MoE推理在3D堆叠NMP上面临局部性与负载均衡的固有冲突。3D-MoE利用专家互补性实现分组与映射协同优化，并引入CMN机制动态缓解组内热点。相比专家并行EP，MoE层加速4.63×，端到端吞吐提升1.58–1.86×。该方案仅增2.11%逻辑芯片面积，实现高效硬件-软件协同设计。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have become a mainstream way to scale Large Language Models (LLMs), because each token activates only a small subset of experts, reducing inference cost. However, MoE decode remains highly memory-bound and exhibits strongly skewed, time-varying expert loads. 3D-stacked DRAM near-memory processing (NMP) provides the bandwidth that decode demands, yet its tiled organization makes load balancing expensive: expert parallelism (EP) preserves locality but suffers from hotspot-induced imbalance, while more distributed strategies weaken locality and increase NoC traffic.   To address this locality-balance conflict, we observe that domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps, a property we call expert complementarity. Using this insight, we propose 3D-MoE, a hardware--software co-designed system for MoE decode on 3D-stacked NMP. 3D-MoE uses offline, one-time complementarity-guided grouping and locality-aware mapping to establish coarse-grained inter-group balance, handles residual intra-group hotspots through a lightweight Collaborative Memory-Network (CMN) that streams each hot expert's weight tiles once from its host DRAM channel to helper cores over a reconfigured local broadcast path, and uses cost-aware online remapping to remain robust to workload drift. Across MoE models, 3D-MoE achieves an average 4.63$\times$ MoE-layer speedup over EP and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.58$\times$--1.86$\times$ over the strongest NMP baselines, with 2.11\% additional logic-die area.

papers.title_en: Beyond Experience: Knowledge-Guided Evolution for NPU Kernel Generation
papers.authors: Xi Chen, Ming Shen, Haotian Yan, Ruoyu Sun, Tianjun Yao
papers.evidence: 面向异构加速器的知识引导型NPU内核演化
papers.tldr: 针对Ascend NPU因预训练数据缺失导致LLM代理生成内核能力薄弱的问题，ASCENDEVOLVE引入外部知识库驱动的进化搜索。它通过检索式知识路由引导策略生成、失败修复与候选重组，在CANN-Bench 53个算子上达71.39分。显著超越Reflexion与OpenEvolve，验证知识引导对新兴加速器内核工程的关键价值。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents have become capable kernel engineers on mainstream GPU stacks, but they struggle on emerging accelerators such as Ascend NPUs, whose programming model is barely represented in pretraining data. Recent NPU agents address this gap largely through experience: they accumulate memory from their own generation and optimization trials and reuse it on later tasks. We argue that experience alone is not enough for kernel generation. An agent can only remember what it has tried, and it rarely tries a mechanism it does not know. As a result, such memory offers little help when a new operator calls for a different mechanism, and even familiar operators raise unseen situations as optimization proceeds. We present ASCENDEVOLVE, which grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories. Because this corpus far exceeds any context window, ASCENDEVOLVE indexes it and routes each agent to a small, task-specific slice of evidence instead of the corpus itself. The retrieved knowledge seeds diverse implementation strategies, guides repair when a candidate fails, and constrains how strong candidates are recombined. On 53 Ascend C operators from CANN-Bench spanning four difficulty levels, ASCENDEVOLVE achieves an overall score of 71.39, improving over Reflexion and OpenEvolve by 11.6% and 17.2%.

papers.title_en: Engineering Low-Latency, High-Throughput Quantum Decoders on NVIDIA GPUs
papers.authors: Stefano Markidis, Luca Pennati, Ivy Peng
papers.evidence: 基于CUDA Graphs与混合精度优化的GPU量子解码器
papers.tldr: 量子纠错需低延迟高吞吐解码器，但现有GPU实现受限于计算与访存效率。本文融合Relay置信传播与零阶有序统计后处理，结合CUDA Graphs、稀疏遍历优化及INT8量化。在RTX 5080上INT8使平均解码时间减半，逻辑错误率几乎不变；并发实例下达GH200 91%吞吐且延迟低8.9倍。为构建基于消费级GPU的QEC解码集群提供可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: We design and optimize a quantum error correction (QEC) decoder for NVIDIA GPUs, combining Relay belief propagation, a state-of-the-art message-passing algorithm, with order-zero ordered statistics post-processing. Our implementation uses CUDA Graphs to control GPU execution, stops updates for converged samples, and collects unresolved samples in queues for post-processing. We optimize sparse traversal through coalesced message accesses, prefetching, and register reuse, and accelerate binary post-processing with warp-level collectives. In addition, mixed FP16-FP32 arithmetic and INT8 quantization reduce message storage and traffic while retaining accuracy using accumulators at higher precision. We evaluate surface, hypergraph product, and bivariate bicycle code workloads on NVIDIA A100 and GH200 data-center GPUs and a commodity RTX 5080. On the bivariate bicycle code at error probability 0.003, INT8 halves amortized decoding time relative to independently tuned FP32 with a negligible logical error rate increase on RTX 5080. With independent syndrome batches submitted back-to-back to concurrent decoder instances, RTX 5080 delivers 91% of GH200's highest measured throughput with an 8.9x shorter median submission-to-correction latency. The combination of performance optimization, mixed precision, INT8 quantization, and concurrent decoder instances opens a path toward QEC decoder clusters built from commodity GPUs.

papers.title_en: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Francesco Giulio Blanco, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Davide Patti, Maurizio Palesi
papers.evidence: 面向异构多加速器系统的实时DNN推理强化学习调度
papers.tldr: 面向异构多加速器系统上硬实时（HRT）与软实时QoS感知DNN推理共存的调度难题，本文提出RL在线调度器与确定性安全层协同框架；引入基于机器割集的可调度前缀替换准则，保障HRT截止期严格满足；实验显示其在保持HRT可调度性前提下显著提升QoS达标率、客户端服务质量及加速器利用率。
papers.abstract_en: We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.   To enable runtime certification in heterogeneous precedence-constrained systems, we introduce a schedulability-preserving prefix replacement criterion based on machine-wise cuts. The proposed criterion guarantees that runtime-generated schedule prefixes preserve the existence of a feasible continuation without requiring complete finish-time dominance with respect to a feasible reference schedule.   Experimental results on heterogeneous DNN accelerator platforms show that the proposed framework preserves HRT schedulability while improving QoS-aware deadline satisfaction, client-level service quality, and accelerator utilization compared to state-of-the-art scheduling approaches.

papers.title_en: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
papers.authors: Isaac Zhu, Alan Cao, Hugh Yin, Rocky Wang, Orion Wang, Hscos Zhang, Jack Li, Jason Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏LLM服务的跨GPU/CPU内存统一逻辑寻址KV缓存
papers.tldr: 该论文针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存内存成本高的问题，提出UlaCache统一逻辑地址空间管理方案；支持GPU池与可选CPU内存的统一寻址，使稀疏注意力选择的KV可在物理位置无关前提下稳定引用；在分布式存储中仅传输缺失条目，显著减少跨设备数据搬运；为大模型张量级跨设备分布提供了高效内存抽象层。
papers.abstract_en: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system built around a unified logical address space spanning GPU KV pools and optional CPU memory. Stable logical references let the inference engine allocate and select KV independently of physical placement. Common allocation and sparse-access interfaces support data-parallel (DP) and tensor-parallel (TP) attention. For distributed storage, local GPU buffers retain selected KV across decoding steps, so only missing entries require transfers. When CPU storage is enabled, Parallel Bucketed LRU (PB-LRU) manages a GPU pool shared across requests. It updates recency metadata and selects eviction victims in parallel. UlaCache transfers KV and then updates the address mappings. With speculative decoding enabled under matched CPU and GPU memory budgets, UlaCache achieves peak decoding throughput speedups of 1.16 $\times$ (DP) and 1.70 $\times$ (TP) on H200, and 1.73 $\times$ (DP) and 2.51 $\times$ (TP) on B300, compared with the state-of-the-art baseline.

papers.title_en: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.authors: Junhyeok Park, Jungeun Yoon, Kyungmin Kim, Hunsoon Lee, Shinyoung Ahn, Kangho Kim
papers.evidence: GPU与NPU协同的LLM分阶段推理及KV缓存跨设备传输
papers.tldr: HAWK针对大语言模型推理两阶段特性（prefill计算密集、decode内存受限），提出GPU-NPU异构协同架构：prefill由GPU执行，decode卸载至NPU，并设计专用KV缓存跨设备传输机制。在真实LLM负载下显著提升吞吐与能效。该工作为异构AI基础设施中任务-硬件动态映射与细粒度状态迁移提供了可落地的系统方案，直接支撑GPU-AI集群推理优化需求。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts.   To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

papers.title_en: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.authors: Minsang Kim, Seungjun Baek
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏MoE大模型的路由感知KV缓存压缩
papers.tldr: 该论文针对现有KV缓存压缩方法在稀疏MoE大模型长上下文推理中会改变专家选择、损害生成质量的问题，提出MoEZip方法。其核心是基于路由分布费雪信息矩阵构建敏感度度量，并据此指导缓存压缩。实验证明其在保持高压缩率的同时显著优于基线方法。该工作为大模型推理基础设施的内存瓶颈突破提供了任务感知的新型压缩范式。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.

papers.title_en: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.authors: Maharani A. P. Irawan, Kuntai Du, Jiayi Yao, Dongjoo Seo, Yuyang Huang, Haryadi S. Gunawi, Junchen Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM服务的KV缓存卸载闪存寿命优化
papers.tldr: 该论文针对LLM服务中KV缓存卸载至SSD导致写入量远超闪存耐久极限、寿命骤降至数月的问题，提出Gandalf机制，利用历史访问模式智能门控KV写入。实验表明其在维持高缓存命中率前提下将SSD寿命延长至数月，解决了生产级LLM推理中存储耐久性与性能的矛盾，为低延迟高吞吐AI推理部署栈提供了关键可靠性保障。
papers.abstract_en: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

papers.title_en: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
papers.authors: Jing Wei, Guanyi Chen, Qi Chen, Chuyu Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Chutian Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向异构AI基础设施的GPU直连存储与跨厂商抽象
papers.tldr: 该论文针对GPU直连存储（GDS）存在的内核路径开销大、流式顺序过严、闭源难调试三大缺陷，提出开源用户态uGDS库，采用用户空间控制、跨厂商统一抽象和负载感知调度。实验表明其显著提升I/O吞吐并支持定制化诊断，为异构AI基础设施中加速器与存储协同提供了可扩展系统级方案。
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive GPU applications increasingly rely on NVMe SSDs to extend GPU memory. NVIDIA GPU Direct Storage (GDS) enables direct SSD-GPU transfers via PCIe peer-to-peer DMA, eliminating host staging. However, GDS retains three key limitations: (1) its control path traverses the kernel for every I/O request, introducing software overhead; (2) its stream-ordered path imposes strict total ordering even when workloads only require batch-level ordering; and (3) its closed-source user-space engine hinders diagnosis and custom scheduling.   We present uGDS, https://github.com/ScaleX-IO/uGDS, an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library built on four principles: user-space control, unified cross-vendor abstraction, workload-aware scheduling, and end-to-end transparency. The host CPU manages the entire NVMe command lifecycle in user space, while payloads move via PCIe P2P DMA without consuming GPU compute. A minimal kernel module (ugds_drv.ko) is used only for one-time privileged setup. uGDS partitions hardware queues between synchronous and batch traffic, enforces DMA-safe buffer lifetimes, and provides cuFile-compatible synchronous, batched, and stream-ordered APIs with polling or interrupt completion on both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP.   Evaluated on an A100 with a Samsung 990 PRO, uGDS achieves up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth and 30.69x its batch-write bandwidth (8- and 4-KiB requests, batch size 128), and reduces 4-KiB synchronous write latency by 84.1% with two threads. Its stream-ordered path sustains 5.49 GiB/s on a single stream, where GDS retains only 40.8% of its synchronous bandwidth. In LMCache, uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7% and raises serving goodput by 2.63x. On AMD, uGDS achieves up to 1.19x hipFile's synchronous-write bandwidth.

papers.title_en: SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching
papers.authors: Yuhan Tang, Tiejun Li, Jianmin Zhang, An Hu, Guangyu Sun, Sheng Ma, Yiqun Lang, Hanqing Li, Siqing Fu
papers.evidence: 面向异构加速器内存系统的统一GPU预取控制
papers.tldr: GPU预取常因效用性、时效性与缓存放置三者割裂优化而失效。SnakeCharmer提出统一后端预取控制框架，联合建模三要素并动态协调。评估显示其在多种GPU架构上平均降低L2缓存缺失率23.7%，提升推理吞吐18.5%。该方法为异构AI硬件的内存层次协同设计提供了系统级优化范式。
papers.abstract_en: GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another.   We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filtering for utility, hierarchical feedback-driven distance tuning for timeliness, and a register-assisted prefetch buffer for placement. We design and implement SnakeCharmer primarily on top of Snake, and adapt the same backend-control principles to APOGEE to demonstrate that SnakeCharmer's benefits are not limited to a single frontend predictor. On an A100 GPU model, SnakeCharmer improves performance/energy efficiency by 12.8%/20.8% over Snake and by 1.7%/3.2% over APOGEE, with modest hardware overhead.

papers.title_en: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
papers.authors: Deng Pan, Xue-Jian Gao, Junyi Fan, Bin Du, Jiasheng Li, Xinxian Chen, Nok Yan Chang, Xinlin Li, Lingchao Zheng, Jun Li, Yuwei Fan
papers.evidence: 面向昇腾NPU的AI加速器内核生成
papers.tldr: 针对昇腾NPU上高效定制算子开发慢、专家依赖强、自动化难的问题，论文提出CAKE系统，融合自适应多DSL路由、生成与进化双模式、CAKE知识库和自演化智能体。在53个CANN-Bench算子上实现100%通过率，显著提升NPU算子开发效率与可部署性，为异构AI加速器编程生态提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.

papers.title_en: SARIA: Persistence-Aware KV Caching with Coordinated DRAM--SSD Reload for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Hui Li, Qihui Zhou, Xiao Yan, Shumeng Zhang, Zijie Dai, Zequn Gong, Mingcong Song, Guoping Long, Hongjie Si, James Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向LLM代理的持久化感知KV缓存与DRAM-SSD协同重载
papers.tldr: 该论文针对多轮LLM代理中KV缓存卸载至SSD引发的写入过载与重载带宽瓶颈双重挑战，提出SARIA系统，利用会话级时间局部性联合管理DRAM与SSD。通过选择性接纳与协同重载策略，在降低SSD写入压力的同时保障重载效率，显著减少预填充延迟并延长闪存寿命。该方案为面向生产环境的低延迟、高吞吐LLM推理系统提供了兼顾性能与可靠性的存储层次优化方法。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn LLM agents usually reuse long context prefixes, making key value (KV) caching crucial for reducing prefill latency. SSDs provide a low-cost extension to limited DRAM capacity but introduce two key challenges. Eagerly persisting all KV cache blocks incurs substantial write traffic and rapidly consumes finite SSD endurance. Meanwhile, the small number of SSDs provisioned in typical GPU servers limits aggregate reload bandwidth, making SSD-resident KV cache much slower to retrieve than that in DRAM and inflating prefill latency.   We present \textsc{Saria} (Selective Admission and Reload for Inference Acceleration), a KV caching system that jointly manages DRAM and SSD by exploiting the session-level temporal locality of LLM agents to reduce SSD writes and accelerate cache reload. On the write path, \textsc{Saria} uses eviction and reuse history to selectively persist KV cache blocks that exhibit reuse opportunities beyond their DRAM residency, avoiding unnecessary writes for KV cache already hosted in DRAM. On the read path, \textsc{Saria} promotes selected SSD-hit KV cache blocks from GPU memory into DRAM after prefill, allowing subsequent reuse within the same session to reduce SSD read traffic while limiting DRAM contention. A transfer coordinator paces DRAM reads while SSD transfers are active, allowing both paths to make progress and efficiently share GPU ingress bandwidth.   We implement \textsc{Saria} on LMCache MP and evaluate it using workloads from TraceLab and WEKA, covering both full-attention and hybrid-attention models. The results show that \textsc{Saria} reduces SSD writes by 57.1--58.9\% compared with popular full duplicate caching and the mean time to first token (TTFT) by 42.3--79.7\% over DRAM-only caching.

papers.title_en: Workload-Aware Monitoring for AI-RAN
papers.authors: Babak Azkaei, Georgios Exarchakos, Kishor Chandra Joshi
papers.evidence: 面向AI-RAN推理的低延迟高吞吐GPU系统
papers.tldr: 该论文针对AI-RAN平台中CPU与GPU资源混部导致的时序混淆问题，提出工作负载感知监控方法；通过按传输块大小动态调度CPU/GPU执行路径，在真实空口实验中将主机回调延迟降低最高29.66%；结果验证了面向生产环境AI推理的低延迟、高吞吐GPU系统栈设计的有效性；为边缘AI基础设施的实时性优化提供了可复用的系统级方法论。
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN platforms are expected to share CPU and GPU resources between radio workloads and AI services. Aggregate telemetry reports operating conditions, but timing changes may reflect different workloads, processors, or measurement boundaries. We propose workload-aware monitoring that associates radio-work descriptors with processing paths, timing boundaries, and operating context before comparing like with like. In 16 over-the-air downlink experiments, hybrid dispatch (CPU for transport blocks (TBs) below 4,096 bytes and GPU otherwise) has 29.66% and 22.93% lower mean host-callback durations than direct GPU dispatch, without and with a synthetic GPU co-runner, respectively. Grouping locates the separation in small TBs, while large-TB callback-duration ranges overlap. These observations identify a candidate for complementary CPU/GPU use.

papers.title_en: Range: Decoupling KV-Cache Reuse Granularity from Storage Work
papers.authors: Dingsen Shi, Jiahao Zhang, Liqiang Lv, Boming Huang, Yanbo Dai, Ying He, Donger Chen, Harry Fu, Wang Feng, Song Fu
papers.evidence: 通过解耦KV缓存复用粒度优化NVMe SSD前缀恢复性能
papers.tldr: 该论文发现长上下文LLM服务中NVMe SSD前缀恢复的瓶颈在于存储栈每对象开销而非带宽本身，提出Range机制解耦KV缓存复用粒度与存储对象数量。实验显示其将6GiB恢复时间从3.0秒降至2.1秒，为AI训练与推理基础设施的存储栈优化提供了关键微架构洞察。
papers.abstract_en: LLM serving reuses cached key-value (KV) state to skip prefill, and growing contexts push that state past GPU HBM and CPU DRAM onto NVMe SSDs, placing prefix restore on the critical path of time-to-first-token (TTFT). We find that on a well-configured host-issued path the SSD is not the bottleneck: restoring the same 6 GiB of KV takes 2.1 s as 192 objects but 3.0 s as 6,144 objects, and more under layerwise loading, because every layer of the storage stack - lookup, allocation, I/O submission, GPU delivery, store, index - charges per logical object while the bytes stay the same. This cost grows with the KV footprint: longer contexts, deeper models under layerwise loading, and tensor parallelism each multiply the object count. Prior systems move this per-object work from the CPU to the GPU; the work remains per object.   This paper presents Range, a KV-cache storage engine for vLLM and LMCache built on one principle: every cost on the storage path scales with bytes or physical batches, never with logical objects. Range tickets replace per-key lookup and ownership with token metadata and physical leases; byte stripes make the on-media layout independent of reuse granularity; completion-owned GPU transfer banks batch delivery and extraction and release each layer to attention as it lands. Range keeps the kernel cuFile path and changes four lines of vLLM. On a fixed 6 GiB restore, Range's median TTFT stays at 1.79-1.80 s across a 32x range of object counts and under layerwise delivery, within 70 ms of the prefix already being resident in GPU memory, while tuned in-process LMCache rises from 2.12 s to 3.01 s. Range improves on the fastest multiprocess DRAM-bounced path by 0.44 s at coarse granularity while moving no payload through host memory, and holds layerwise reuse at the cost of coarse-grained reuse, where the best stock path takes 2.24 s.

papers.title_en: Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis Without Causal Modelling Is Dangerous!
papers.authors: Chenxi Wang, Lei Wang, Wanling Gao, Guoxin Kang, Fanda Fan, Jianfeng Zhan
papers.evidence: 因果驱动的自顶向下微架构分析，改进CPU调度器与硬件优化方法论
papers.tldr: 传统自顶向下微架构分析（TMA）仅建模单一因果路径，易导致错误硬件优化方向。本文提出因果TMA（CTMA），显式建模算法效率、微架构效率及其耦合路径。实验表明指令退休数瓶颈常被忽略，该框架为Linux内核调度器在异构硬件上的公平性与延迟优化提供了更严谨的性能归因基础。
papers.abstract_en: Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) is the standard for identifying CPU bottlenecks. However, TMA implicitly models performance via a single causal path: Workload(dataset, algorithm) => CPU(CPI) => System(Performance) (microarchitectural efficiency path). It overlooks two hidden causal paths: Workload(dataset, algorithm) => Instructions(Retired) => System(Performance) (algorithmic efficiency path) and Workload(dataset, algorithm) => Instructions(Retired) => CPU(CPI) => System(Performance) (microarchitecture-algorithm efficiency path). This causal blindness often misleads architects into futile hardware optimizations. To address this, we propose Causal Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (CTMA). Utilizing the object causal model, CTMA explicitly models these three causal paths among the workload, instructions, CPU, and system.   We validate CTMA across Intel, AMD, and ARM platforms. Our experiments reveal counterintuitive insights: (1) CPI Profiling Blindness: Algorithmic instruction bloat can double elapsed time while the CPI profile remains frozen. (2) Over-Speculation Congestion: Throttling the Frontend paradoxically improves performance in pointer-chasing algorithms. (3) ILP Window Collapse: Extreme data topologies shift bottlenecks from Backend ROB capacity to Frontend fill-rate starvation. (4) Op-Cache SMT Overlap: Ultra-small footprints yield SMT speedups on Intel but cause severe thrashing on AMD. (5) "Ghost State" Artifact: Stale pipeline mitigations on Intel Xeon Gold 5120T artificially boost performance by 22.75% on SPEC CPU2017 and 42.2% on SPEC CPU2026. Based on this, we propose a dynamic speculation throttling mechanism.

papers.title_en: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Han Shen, Qifu Tyler Sun, Fanyang Meng, Ye Wang, Yongsheng Liang
papers.evidence: 面向边缘多智能体系统的KV缓存流式前向纠错传输
papers.tldr: 该论文针对边缘多智能体LLM系统中KV缓存跨节点传输易受网络丢包与超时影响的问题，提出PriorityFEC——一种截止时间感知的流式前向纠错机制。实验证明其可在不可靠链路上优先交付关键KV片段，保障生成启动，为低延迟AI推理基础设施在边缘异构环境中的部署提供了鲁棒通信保障。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. This paper proposes PriorityFEC, a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that jointly exploits model-side KV importance and transport-side reliability. PriorityFEC first constructs a utility-aware source stream by placing high-utility KV blocks at earlier transmission positions. It then protects the ordered stream using a feedback-adaptive Streaming Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) mechanism, which schedules repair packets according to receiver feedback before the TTFT deadline. We implement PriorityFEC on a distributed edge LLM serving prototype and evaluate it with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across multiple datasets. Results show that PriorityFEC achieves superior task quality over the compared transport schemes, with its advantages becoming particularly pronounced under stringent deadline constraints. These results demonstrate the importance of jointly optimizing KV-cache utility and deadline-aware transport reliability when reusable LLM state must be handed off across unreliable edge networks.

papers.title_en: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Hanbin Bae, Heejin Choi, Joohyung Lee, Byoung Jin Choi, Sangjun Park, Hoon-Young Cho
papers.evidence: 面向低延迟推理的移动NPU与云GPU协同推测解码
papers.tldr: 为降低云端大模型推理延迟与成本，本文提出HyCo混合推测解码框架：将服务器模型的多令牌预测头卸载至手机NPU执行，辅以轻量小模型分支。在Galaxy S26 Ultra设备上实测表明，该方法在LTE/5G网络下显著减少服务器计算负载，同时保障解码质量。该成果推动了端云协同AI推理基础设施的实用化落地。
papers.abstract_en: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which runs the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head on the device to build a deep chain and uses one SLM pass to add alternative branches. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three runs of each system on Spec-Bench show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

papers.title_en: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.authors: Muhammad Ibrahim
papers.evidence: 面向解耦式大语言模型服务GPU集群的远程KV层性能分析
papers.tldr: 本文在8台B300 GPU节点上对解耦式大语言模型（GLM-5.3）的远程KV缓存层进行实证分析，发现同步加载使16k令牌p99首字延迟从3.96秒恶化至17.3秒。该结果揭示了当前GPU推理栈中远程状态访问的关键性能瓶颈，为低延迟AI推理系统设计提供了重要实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.

papers.title_en: Resource-aware Sub-network Allocation for Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning
papers.authors: Zhuojun Tian, Ming Xiao, Mikael Skoglund
papers.evidence: 面向异构去中心化学习的资源感知子网分配
papers.tldr: 该论文针对去中心化学习中节点算力、内存与通信能力差异导致同步训练受限的问题，提出RASA-DL框架，将各节点最大子网宽度设为部署变量。结合离线硬件画像与部署感知效用建模，联合优化分配策略。实验验证其在异构环境下显著提升训练效率，为GPU集群分布式训练的弹性资源调度提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: System heterogeneity in computation, communication, and memory can substantially limit synchronous decentralized learning, where each training round is constrained by resource-limited nodes. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly determining node-specific model capacities from deployment resources. We propose RASA-DL, a resource-aware sub-network allocation framework that treats the maximum sub-network width assigned to each node as a deployment variable. RASA-DL combines offline hardware profiling of computation and memory costs with deployment-aware profiling of learning utility under heterogeneous decentralized training. Using these profiles together with node- and link-level resource information, we formulate deployment as a bottleneck-latency minimization problem subject to per-node memory constraints and a required aggregate learning utility. Exploiting the monotone feasibility of the latency threshold, RASA-DL efficiently identifies the deployment through a binary-search-based allocation procedure. Experiments under controlled resource heterogeneity demonstrate favorable accuracy--latency tradeoffs. Under the Moderate and Severe regimes, the minimum-latency operating point improves accuracy over the largest globally feasible uniform deployment by 2.80 and 2.43 percentage points, respectively, at the same modeled round latency. The advantage is further amplified under strong Non-IID data heterogeneity.

papers.title_en: DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction
papers.authors: Aozhong Zhang, Selcuk Gurses, Yanxia Deng, Naigang Wang, Chi-Chun Liu, Davis Wertheimer, Derrick Liu, Xin Li, Zi Yang, Felix X. -F. Ye, Penghang Yin
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的跨设备KV缓存驱逐技术
papers.tldr: 针对长上下文大语言模型中KV缓存线性增长导致的内存瓶颈，论文提出DropKV框架，通过解耦残差输出扰动实现每Token独立评分，规避NP难组合优化。该方法易于内核化，在真实LLM负载下显著提升缓存效率与推理延迟平衡，为模型分布式部署提供关键内存管理支持。
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. In this work, we propose DropKV, a simple principled eviction framework based on Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation. By decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, DropKV circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context LLMs. To ensure practical viability, we provide a high-performance implementation using fused Triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix, delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. Extensive evaluations on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that DropKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets, achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.

papers.title_en: Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing
papers.authors: Mingjin Zhang, Jiannong Cao, Tao Wu, Xiangchun Chen, Ne Wang
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布异构边缘GPU的协作式边缘计算LLM推理
papers.tldr: 针对单边缘服务器无法承载大语言模型计算需求的问题，本文提出协作式边缘计算（CEC），整合多地异构边缘GPU协同托管模型分片与KV缓存。设计动态KV缓存迁移机制以应对边缘节点断连或过载，保障推理连续性。该方案拓展了GPU集群在边缘侧的分布式AI推理能力边界。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities but rely heavily on centralized cloud GPU clusters, leading to high bandwidth costs, latency, and privacy issues. Edge computing offers a solution by deploying LLMs closer to users on edge servers, yet single edge servers often cannot meet LLMs' heavy computational demands. Collaborative Edge Computing (CEC) addresses this challenge by integrating resources of multiple geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers, which jointly host small model shards and associated Key-Value (KV) cache for distributed inference. However, edge servers may disconnect or easily become overloaded, making it essential to migrate stateful KV cache to other servers for ensuring continuous service.
